name: Te Amo: The Bay of Hope
source:
A writer arrives at a beachside guesthouse seeking inspiration for her novel. She doesn't expect the three others whose fates bring them to the very same guesthouse.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Te_Amo_Volume_1]romance-club.fandom[/url]
